result.title: Think Once, Act Fast: Cost-Effective Recursive Self-Improvement for Decision Model Harness
result.summary: Fast System-1 models enable responsive actions but struggle with complex or unfamiliar tasks. Large language model (LLM)-based System-2 provides strong reasoning capabilities, yet repeated invocation incurs substantial latency and computational costs. To bridge this gap, we propose JevRSI, a System-1/System-2 collaboration framework that transforms LLM reasoning into transferable decision support through recursive harness improvement. A Jev-style System-1 model enables low-latency action selection, while an asynchronous System-2 LLM develops a modular harness. The harness integrates procedures, state memory, and world models to provide decision contexts spanning the past, present, and future. Utility-driven retrieval selects modules based on both contextual relevance and their utility on previous tasks. Environmental feedback guides targeted revisions and enables recursive self-improvement. Experiments across three datasets show that JevRSI consistently improves decision quality, matching or surpassing LLM agents in several settings. It preserves low-latency execution with favorable performance-cost trade-offs. Moreover, System-2 development interventions decrease as the harness evolves, amortizing System-2 costs through continuous improvement. Our project is available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/JevRSI.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 JevRSI：轻量 System-1 模型负责低延迟动作选择，异步 System-2 LLM 构建含流程、状态记忆与世界模型的模块化 harness，并按上下文相关性与历史效用检索模块，借环境反馈递归改进。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，但其「按历史效用检索外部模块、把重型 LLM 推理摊薄为可复用决策上下文」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/STOP 的计算预算分配与停止判据设计。
